description: Teammate 1 external-event list for Jan-Jun 2026, following the AGENTS.md external-evidence schema. To be merged with the Codex teammate's outlier_event_registry.json once that file is published. branch_exposure is 'unknown' for every event because branch locations are not confirmed by the company.

field_notes.published_at: When the event was publicly known. If it is on or after event_start, the event could not have been used in a forecast made the day before.
field_notes.known_before_event: True only if a source shows the event was announced before it started (usable as a forecast-time flag, subject to exposure checks).
field_notes.validation_status: event_verified = date confirmed by the cited sources; partially_verified = sources disagree or only secondary sources; not_found = teammate 1 searches found no source (the Codex registry may have one); unsourced = rule-based date with no source attached yet.
field_notes.association_in_data: What our notebooks found for this event. Association is not causation; see AGENTS.md.

events.affected_geography: National; heaviest in South Lebanon, the Bekaa and Beirut's southern suburbs
events.mechanism: Security risk and fear of movement, displacement, supply disruption and cost increases
events.association_in_data: Notebook 02 and the README reconciliation: orders +2.8% vs the pre-war trend (all branches), Garden -2.9%. Notebook 09: March 2 itself -1% (Harbour evening -42%, q = 0.11). No negative association detected; exposure unknown.
events.notes: End date is the last full day before the cessation of hostilities took effect (00:00 Beirut time on April 17). Hostilities continued at lower intensity afterwards.

events.affected_geography: Central and coastal Beirut (including Corniche al-Mazraa, Hay el Sellom, southern Beirut), Sidon, Tyre, the Bekaa, South Lebanon. North Lebanon and Mount Lebanon not mentioned.
events.mechanism: Mass-casualty strikes at rush hour without warning (357 killed per the cited infobox); fear of movement
events.association_in_data: Notebook 09: -1% vs expected for all branches; strongest cell Garden evening -31%; nothing survives the false-discovery correction (q = 0.83). README (Codex screen): about -1%.
events.notes: No advance warning, so not a forecast-time feature.

events.mechanism: Reduced security risk; possible return of displaced people
events.association_in_data: Notebook 02: orders after the ceasefire stayed near the pre-war trend overall; Garden further below its own trend. Notebook 09: April 17 itself 0% vs expected (q = 0.98).
events.notes: Announced by the US on Thursday April 16; effective 17:00 EST April 16 = 00:00 April 17 Beirut time. Sources disagree slightly on the exact UTC time (21:00 vs 22:00 GMT). 10-day initial period, then extended (see the next events).
Three-week extension announced April 23 (single secondary source).
45-day extension (single secondary source); end date computed as 45 days.

events.mechanism: Commitment not to target Beirut's southern suburbs
Political uncertainty: Israel and Lebanon agreed a conditional ceasefire; Hezbollah rejected it on June 4
events.notes: Sources describe it as agreed June 3/4; Hezbollah rejection reported June 4.

events.mechanism: Tent camp of displaced families on the waterfront (reported from March), relocated to a municipal plot in May, only a few dozen tents left by about June 25
events.association_in_data: Notebook 09: June 24 -14% all branches, Uptown -38% (evening -50%); does not survive the correction (q = 0.33). Teammate 1 found a Reuters-sourced report dated June 23 and a Reuters photo dated June 25, not a June 24 Reuters article.
events.notes: Start and end are the reporting window, not exact dates. Candidate mechanism only; not a verified cause at any branch.

events.mechanism: Large evening gatherings of graduates and families near AUB
events.association_in_data: Notebook 09: June 5 +12% (evening +15%), June 6 -1% vs expected, all branches; neither survives the false-discovery correction. README: June 5 network +11.3%, evening +14.5%.
events.notes: June 5: honorary doctorate and graduate ceremony, 19:30. June 6: undergraduate ceremony, 19:30. The end time is an estimate. Published schedule date not captured, but commencement dates are announced well in advance. Haigazian graduation (cited in the README) not verified by teammate 1.

events.affected_geography: Downtown Beirut: Martyrs' Square, Riad el Solh, Weygand, Amir Bachir, Damascus Street, Bab Idriss, Salim Salam slope, the Riad el Solh-Salim Salam tunnel
events.mechanism: Road closures and parking bans for the anniversary of Rafik Hariri's assassination (Martyrs' Square isolated from midnight; full closures from 06:00)
events.association_in_data: Notebook 09: -12% all branches, Harbour -21%, Garden morning -81%; does not survive the false-discovery correction (q = 0.23). README: network -18.5%, Harbour -28.9%.
events.notes: Source found by the Codex teammate (reports/source_reconciliation.md) and checked by teammate 1 on 2026-10-17: ISF notice published 13 February 2026. Teammate 1's earlier search had not found it. Also a public holiday and a Saturday. Exposure still unknown: branch locations are not confirmed.

events.affected_geography: Beirut Waterfront (start/finish opposite Seaside Arena; routes past the Hilton, St. George Yacht Club, Zeitouna Bay, Four Seasons, Riviera Hotel and Luna Park)
events.mechanism: Morning charity run (Beirut Marathon Association 'One Run Global': 1, 5, 10 and 21.1 km) with road closures, 06:30-12:00
events.association_in_data: Notebook 09: -6% all branches, evening -15%; does not survive the correction (q = 0.90). README: network -7.9%, evening -16.5%.
events.notes: Source found by the Codex teammate (reports/source_reconciliation.md) and checked by teammate 1 on 2026-10-17: ISF notice published 22 May 2026. Teammate 1's earlier search had not found it. Exposure still unknown.

events.mechanism: Clocks move forward one hour; could shift recorded transaction hours if timestamps are local time
events.association_in_data: The README notes the clock change cannot explain the March 28 daytime spike (it starts the following day).
events.notes: Council of Ministers Secretariat memo 64/M dated 16 March 2026: clocks forward one hour at midnight between 28 and 29 March (Decision 5 of 20 August 1998). Source found by the Codex teammate and checked by teammate 1 on 2026-10-17. Relevant to whether transaction timestamps follow daylight saving time (question 4 in reports/company_information_request.md).

events.affected_geography: National (regional April changes: North +2.54%, Mount Lebanon +2.71%, Beirut +2.02%)
events.mechanism: CPI +4.91% in March and +3.04% in April; food +18-19% year-on-year; fuel and transport costs up sharply. Likely raises ingredient and operating costs
events.association_in_data: Notebook 08: recorded list prices and unit costs did not change at all in Jan-Jun 2026; demand showed no change in trend.
events.notes: The March CPI release date was not captured (February figures were published March 26 and April figures May 21), so published_at is left empty. Monthly data, so not a daily forecast feature. Full figures in data/external/lebanon_cpi_2026H1.json.

events.mechanism: Public holiday and extended public-administration closure
events.association_in_data: Notebook 03: March 20 -14% and March 21 -17% vs expected. Notebook 09: -15% and -16% (all branches); neither survives the false-discovery correction.
events.notes: A secondary source cites Prime Minister Memorandum 6 of March 19, 2026, closing public administrations through March 23 (two days longer than the holiday list). Not checked against the Official Gazette. Lunar date, so announced only shortly before.

events.mechanism: Public holidays: Jan 1, Jan 6, Feb 9, Feb 14, Mar 20-21, Mar 25, Apr 3, Apr 5, Apr 10, Apr 12, May 1, May 25, May 27, May 29, Jun 16, Jun 26
events.association_in_data: Notebook 03: holidays average about 0% vs expected; Harbour has 5 of 17 outside its normal range (Labour Day +48%). README: only Harbour on May 1 survives the multiple-testing screen (q = 0.023). Notebook 09: Harbour on May 1 +46% vs expected is the strongest checked cell but does not survive this notebook's correction (q = 0.13).
events.notes: Fixed-date holidays are known well in advance. Lunar holidays (Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Hijri New Year, Ashura) are marked tentative by Banque du Liban and sources differ by a day (for example Ashura June 25 or 26, second Eid al-Adha day May 28 or 29). Per-holiday detail is in notebook 03.
